title: .revloop.json
description: Project configuration for revloop. Every field is optional; anything absent is auto-detected and shown in the resolved-configuration table with source=detected.

version.description: Config format version. An unknown major version aborts rather than degrading.

baseBranch.description: Null or absent: read from gh repo view --json defaultBranchRef.

branchPrefixes.description: Absent: derived from the repository's own commit subjects.

verify.description: Commands run before pushing. Shown in the resolved table BEFORE they run, and deliberately excluded from allowed-tools so the permission system always sees them.

verifyNotes.description: Which CI job the umbrella verify command does not reproduce, if any. The shape of this gap is universal; its answer differs per project and may be empty.

roundSource.description: How the round number is derived when resuming. trigger-comments counts what was actually fired and does not require the round number in commit subjects.

verifiedLabel.description: Label introducing the list of commands actually run, e.g. "Verified:".

trailers.description: {model} expands to the running model's name. No vendor address is stamped by default.

defaults.description: Defaults for the command flags. A flag always overrides its default.

reviewers.description: Adds to, or overrides, the built-in presets. Every pattern here is used model-side only; none of it reaches a shell or a jq program.

trigger.description: Posted verbatim to GitHub. Control characters are rejected; a value already containing 'revloop:trigger' is rejected.

botLogin.description: Write it with the [bot] suffix. It is stripped before comparing against GraphQL, which omits it.

cleanPatterns.description: Anchor these at the start. A reviewer's clean phrase often has a varying tail, so equality tests break.

ignoreCommentPatterns.description: Non-terminal comments, such as a preamble posted before the real review.
